_note: Full section as it stands in the source term bank (Kolosalio Lea mo hono 'Uhinga, Agriculture section by Viliami). This is the most complete section in the document - every entry has both English and Tongan definitions. The fakau'a (glottal stop) has not yet been normalized to a single consistent character - a native-speaker pass should standardise this before the content is considered launch-ready.

entries.en_definition: Commercial enterprises involved in producing, processing, and selling agricultural products.
entries.to_definition: Kautaha ngoue kihono to, ngaohi moe fakatau e ngaahi koloa fakangoue

entries.en_definition: A person skilled or involved in agricultural science or farming.
entries.to_definition: Tokotaha mataotao mo 'ilo lahi kihe ngoue

entries.en_definition: The practice of cultivating soil, growing crops, and raising animals for food, fiber, and other products.
entries.to_definition: Koe faahing ngaue ki hono teuteu'i e kelekele, to e ngoue moe tauhi monumanu kihe me'atokoni, naunau moe ngaahi me'a kehe.

entries.en_definition: Integrating trees with crops or livestock.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fa'ahinga ngaue 'oku to fakataha 'ae 'ulu-'akau moe ngoue pe fakataha moe tauhi monumonu

entries.en_definition: The science of soil management and crop production.
entries.to_definition: Koe faahinga 'ilo moe founga ki hono tokangaekina e kelekele moe to e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Combining fish farming with hydroponics, where fish waste provides nutrients for plants.
entries.to_definition: Ko e faama ika 'oku tānaki atu ki he ngoue he vai pea hoko 'a e fakaveve 'a e ika ko e ivi tokoni ki he 'akau.

entries.en_definition: Variety of living organisms in an ecosystem.
entries.to_definition: Ko e kalasi kehekehe 'o e me'amo'ui 'i honau 'ātaki fakafisikale.

entries.en_definition: A holistic, ecological approach to farming that treats the farm as a self-sustaining system, often guided by lunar cycles.
entries.to_definition: Koe fa'ahinga ngoue oku ngaohi ngoue'anga ke mo'ui 'o fakatatau kihe tu'u 'ae mahina

entries.en_definition: Measures to protect plants and animals from disease and pests.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fokotu'utu'u ke malu'i e 'akau moe fanga monumanu meihe ngaohi mahaki moe ngaahi insekite maumau.

entries.en_definition: Farming that adapts to and mitigates climate change.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fa'ahinga ngoue 'oku maliuliu mo fakasi'isi'i fakatatau kihe femaliuaki 'ae 'Ea.

entries.en_definition: The parts of the agricultural industry, such as crop production, livestock farming, processing, distribution, and marketing.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha ngaahi kongokonga e fa'unga 'oe ngoue, hange koe to ngoue, tauhi monumanu, ngaohi, fetukutuku moe faka-maketi

entries.en_definition: Traditional farming using synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, and high-yield crop varieties.
entries.to_definition: Koe fa'ahinga ngoue anga maheni ngaue'aki e fafanga, faito'o moe ngaahi kalasi ngoue 'oku fua pe foha lahi.

entries.en_definition: Farming focused primarily on plant production rather than livestock.
entries.to_definition: Koe faama 'oku tokanga taha pe kihe to e ngoue pe 'akau-fua kae 'ikai kau ai e tauhi monumanu

entries.en_definition: Techniques to grow healthy, high-yield crops, including planting schedules, pest control, and nutrient supply.
entries.to_definition: Koe fa'ahing founga ngoue 'oku to ke mo'ui, fua pe foha lahi, kau ai moe taimi to, tokanga'i e maumau e fili moe fafannga e ngoue

entries.en_definition: The growing and harvesting of plants for food, feed, fiber, or fuel.
entries.to_definition: Koe to mo toli pe ta'aki e ákau kihe me'atokoni, fafanga monumanu, naunau pe lolo

entries.en_definition: Planting different crops in a planned sequence on the same land to maintain soil fertility and reduce pests.
entries.to_definition: Koe to fetongitongi e ngoue 'ihe feitu'u tatau ke pukepuke e kelekele mo fakasi'si'i e fili e ngoue.

entries.en_definition: Someone (or a tool/machine) that prepares and works the soil for planting.
entries.to_definition: Tokotaha pe ko ha me'angaue kihe teuteu mo ngaohi e kelekele kihe to e ngoue

entries.en_definition: Removing unwanted plants (weeds) that compete with crops for nutrients, water, and sunlight.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono ta'aki e ngaahi vao oku fe'auhi moe ngoue kihe fafanga, vai moe la'a.

entries.en_definition: Methods to prevent or control damage to crops from diseases, insects, and other pests.
entries.to_definition: Founga ke fakafepaki pe mapule'i áki e maumau ngaahi fili e ngoue

entries.en_definition: An area of land where crops are grown.
entries.to_definition: Koe konga kelekele 'oku to ai e ngoue

entries.en_definition: Land used for growing crops or raising animals.
entries.to_definition: Konga 'api óku ngaue'aki kihe to e ngoue pe tauhi monumanu

entries.en_definition: A substance (organic or chemical) added to soil to supply nutrients for plant growth.
entries.to_definition: Koe fa'ahinga fafanga ngaohi pe fakanatula 'oku tanaki kihe kelekele kene fafanga e tupu 'ae 'akau

entries.en_definition: Precision, Hydroponics, Aquaponics, Vertical Farming.
entries.to_definition: Ngoue Taimi-totonu, Ngoue Vai, Ngoue femaliuaki, ngoue fakafungavaka

entries.en_definition: Conventional, Organic, Regenerative, Biodynamic Farming.
entries.to_definition: Ngoue anga-maheni, Ngoue fakanatula, Ngoue Fakamo'ui, Ngoue Ivi-fa'ahita'u

entries.en_definition: Organism whose genetic material has been altered by biotechnology.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha me'amo'ui kuo liliu hono hako fakanatula 'aki founga fakaonopooni

entries.en_definition: A person who cultivates plants, crops, or trees for sale or use.
entries.to_definition: Tokotaha 'oku to 'akau, ngoue pe 'ulu-'akau ke fakatau pe ngaohi

entries.en_definition: A person or machine that gathers crops when they are ripe.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha tokotaha pe misini 'oku tanaki pe toli e fua e 'akau he taimi 'oku momoho ai.

entries.en_definition: The process of gathering mature crops from the fields.
entries.to_definition: Koe hono tanaki pe toli e ngoue meihe ngoue'anga

entries.en_definition: The science and art of growing fruits, vegetables, flowers, and ornamental plants.
entries.to_definition: Koe 'ilo moe founga hono to e 'akau fua, vesitapolo, ngoue matala'i-'akau moe ngaahi 'akau kakala

entries.en_definition: Growing plants without soil, using nutrient-rich water solutions.
entries.to_definition: Koe founga ngoue 'oku to 'ihe vai 'oku 'iai e fafanga ke tupu ai e ngoue

entries.en_definition: Combines biological, chemical, and cultural practices (seasonal cropping, crop-rotation, etc.) to control insect pests in agriculture.
entries.to_definition: Ko e ngaue fakataha áki e founga fakanatula ('inisekite maumau/me'amo'ui kaini-kavea), faito'o (filifili) moe founga ngoue (filifili fa'ahita'u), ngoue fetongitongi to mapule'i 'aki ha inisekite maumau kihe ngoue

entries.en_definition: Growing two or more different crops together on the same land.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono tō fakataha ha ngoue kehekehe é 2 pe lahi ange he feitu'u tatau pe

entries.en_definition: Supplying water to crops through artificial means (e.g., canals, sprinklers, drip systems).
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fu'ifu'i e ngoue 'aki ha founga á e tangata hange ko hono fakatafe, pe me'afu'ifu'i fana pe to'ito'i

entries.en_definition: Caring for and raising animals such as cattle, sheep, poultry, and pigs.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono tauhi e monumanu hange koe fanga pulu, sipi, moa pe puaka

entries.en_definition: Animal dung or compost used as a natural fertilizer.
entries.to_definition: Koe te'e monumanu 'oku ngaohi koe fafanga fakanatula

entries.en_definition: Adding animal dung or other organic matter to the soil to improve fertility.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono tanaki e te'e-monumanu pe ko ha me'akehe fakanatula ke fakalelei kelekele

entries.to_term: Ngoue faka-natula ('Ikai kau ha Fafanga Ngaohi pe Faito'o)
entries.en_definition: Farming without synthetic chemicals, focusing on natural fertilizers and pest control.
entries.to_definition: Ko faama 'oku 'ikai ngaue'aki ha fafanga ngaohi, kae fakatefito pe he fafanga fakanatula moe mapule'i e fili e ngoue

entries.en_definition: A person or machine that plants seeds or seedlings.
entries.to_definition: Koe tokotaha pe me'angaue kihe to e tenga'i ákau pe pulopula

entries.en_definition: Using a plough to cut and turn over the upper layer of soil before planting.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono palau e kelekele ke fulihi mo fakamolu e kelekele pea toki to e ngoue

entries.en_definition: Processing, storing, and transporting crops after harvest, including cooling, cleaning, sorting and packing.
entries.to_definition: Koe ngāue kotoa hili hono toli pe ta'aki e ngoue kau ai hono fakamokomoko, fufulu, filifili pea fa'o

entries.en_definition: Using technology (e.g., GPS, sensors, drones) to monitor and optimize farming operations.
entries.to_definition: Ngaue'aki e me'angaue onopooni (GPS, Sensor, drones) ke taimi'i áki e ngaue kihe ngoue

entries.en_definition: Farming methods that restore soil health, biodiversity, and ecosystem balance.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fa'ahinga faama óku ngaue'aki e founga 'oku ne pukepuke e mo'ui lelei áe kelekele, mo'ui kehekehe moe potupotu tatau 'ae 'atakai

entries.en_definition: Efforts to improve living standards, infrastructure, and economic opportunities in rural areas.
entries.to_definition: Koe ngaahi feinga kotoa ke fakalakalaka e tukunga mo'ui, ngaahi langa moe tu'umalie he feitu'u tuku'uta

entries.en_definition: Practices to maintain or improve soil health, fertility, and structure.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha ngaahi ngaue ke pukepuke mo fakalelei'i e mo'ui aé kelekele, fafanga moe hono fa'unga

entries.en_definition: Planting seeds in the soil for germination and growth.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono tō e tengaí 'akau kihe kelekele ke pa hake pea tupu.

entries.en_definition: Farming mainly to feed the farmer's household, leaving little to no surplus for sale or trade.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha fa'ahinga faama 'oku fakataumu'a e ngoue moe monumanu kotoa ki he fiema'u áe famili 'o ikai ke fakatau pe faka-maketi ha me'a.

entries.en_definition: Farming that meets current needs without harming the ability of future resources to sustain the planet.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha faama 'oku nau ngoue kihe fiema'u ó e 'aho ni kae kei tolonga pe kelekele moe me'amo'ui kotoa kihe kaha'u

entries.en_definition: A person or machine that loosens or turns the soil.
entries.to_definition: Ko ha tokotaha pe me'angaue ki hono fulihi mo fakamolu e kelekele

entries.en_definition: Turning, loosening, or mixing soil in preparation for planting.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fulihi, vekei mo fakamolu e kelekele teuteu kihe to e ngoue

entries.en_definition: Growing crops in stacked layers indoors, often with artificial lighting.
entries.to_definition: Koe ngoue 'oku to fehilihili'i 'i fale, mo ngaue 'aki e maama'uhila

entries.en_definition: Handling and recycling agricultural waste (like manure, crop residue, packaging) to reduce environmental impact.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono ngaohi mo vilovilohi e veve mei he ngoue hange koe te'e-monumanu moe toenga ngoue, 'o fakaáonga'i koe fafanga ngoue mo fakasi'sisi'i ai e vevea hotau 'atakai

entries.en_definition: Efficient use and conservation of water resources for farming.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono ngaue'aki fakapotopoto mo fakasi'isi'i e maumau vai kihe ngoue
